name: Buseoksa
heritage: part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: Buseoksa (Korean: 부석사; Hanja: 浮石寺) is a Buddhist temple located near the mountain Bonghwangsan in Buseok-myeon, Yeongju, South Korea. It was founded by the prominent scholar-monk Uisang in 676. Korean Huayan school was highly celebrated here by the lectures of Uisang, who was later called the respected scholar of Buseok and later the school also gained the name Buseok school.
